note: Model names and sizes come from the tag pages on ollama.com/library (checked 2026-09-20); DeepSeek-V4 data comes from its Hugging Face page and the Unsloth documentation. Sizes are download sizes at the default quantization (usually 4-bit). Strength tags are inferred from the model family and official notes; they are not benchmark results.

families.name: Qwen 3.8 / 3.6 / 3.5
families.desc: 3.8 and 3.6 are the two newest generations (stronger at coding and professional work) and currently come only in large sizes; the small sizes (0.8B-9B) live in 3.5. The whole line accepts text and image input.

models.note: Newest generation, coding and professional work
models.note_zh: 最新一代,编程与专业工作

models.note: Lightest on resources; for modest machines or fallback only
models.note_zh: 最省资源,适合低配电脑或仅做兜底

models.note: The sweet spot between quality and speed

families.desc_zh: 3.8 与 3.6 是最新两代(编程与专业工作更强),目前只有大尺寸;小尺寸(0.8B~9B)在 3.5 里。全系支持文本+图像输入。

families.name: Gemma 4
families.desc: Reasoning and multimodality (text/image). e2b and e4b are the small on-device sizes.
families.desc_zh: 推理与多模态(文本/图像)。e2b/e4b 是面向端侧的小型号。

families.name: gpt-oss
families.desc: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning model, strong at reasoning and agent tasks.

models.note_zh: 需要 80GB 以上内存/显存

families.desc_zh: OpenAI 的开放权重推理模型,擅长推理与智能体任务。

families.name: Muse Glimmer
families.desc: Meta's latest open model for always-on local agents: tool calling, long tasks and recovery after failure. Text and image input.
families.desc_zh: Meta 面向「常驻本地智能体」的最新开放模型:工具调用、长任务、失败后恢复。文本+图像输入。

families.name: DeepSeek V3.1 / R1 distills
families.desc: DeepSeek models that run locally on Ollama: V3.1 (the successor to V3, mixed thinking / non-thinking, 671B) and the R1 distills (built on Qwen/Llama, not V3 itself). The newest V4 is cloud-only on Ollama; for local use, see the self-hosted DeepSeek service below.

models.note_zh: 完整 671B MoE,服务器级硬件

families.desc_zh: Ollama 上可本地运行的 DeepSeek:V3.1(V3 的后续版本,思考/非思考混合,671B)和 R1 蒸馏小模型(基于 Qwen/Llama,不是 V3 本身)。最新的 V4 在 Ollama 只有云端版,本地请用下面的「自建 DeepSeek 服务」。

families.name: GLM 4.7 Flash
families.desc: The strongest all-round model in the ~30B class, balancing capability and efficiency. Newer GLM-5.x is currently cloud-only on Ollama.
families.desc_zh: 30B 级里综合最强的一档,兼顾性能与效率。更新的 GLM-5.x 在 Ollama 目前只有云端版。

families.name: Nemotron 3.5 / 3
families.desc: Open MoE agent model with a long context (up to 1M).
families.desc_zh: 开放的 MoE 智能体模型,长上下文(最高 1M)。

families.name: Granite 4.2
families.desc: Enterprise-grade open model: multilingual, coding, RAG, tool calling and structured JSON output.
families.desc_zh: 企业级开放模型:多语言、编程、RAG、工具调用、结构化 JSON 输出。

families.name: Mistral Medium 3.5 / Ministral 3
families.desc: Medium 3.5 is Mistral's flagship (instruction following, reasoning and coding in one); Ministral 3 targets on-device use. Both accept image input.

models.note: Previous-generation Small, good at function calling
models.note_zh: 上一代 Small,函数调用较好

families.desc_zh: Medium 3.5 是 Mistral 的旗舰(指令/推理/编程合一);Ministral 3 面向端侧。均支持图像输入。

families.name: Phi-4
families.desc: A 14B reasoning-oriented small model; its context is only 16K, so it is not suited to long documents.
families.desc_zh: 14B 的推理型小模型;上下文只有 16K,不适合长文本。

families.name: LFM 2.5
families.desc: Hybrid-architecture model for fast on-device tool calling (8B, about 1B active).
families.desc_zh: 端侧快速工具调用的混合架构模型(8B,激活约 1B)。

families.name: OLMo 3.1
families.desc: A fully open model (data, code and weights) with instruct and think variants.
families.desc_zh: 全开放(数据、代码、权重)的语言模型,有指令版和思考版。

families.name: Laguna / North / Ornith
families.desc: Models aimed at code and long tasks: Poolside's Laguna XS 2.1 (33B MoE, 3B active), Cohere's North Mini Code (30B MoE) and Ornith 1.5 (check the Ollama page for vendor details).

models.note: Poolside · OpenMDW-1.1 licence; roughly 36GB of RAM
models.note_zh: Poolside · OpenMDW-1.1 许可;约需 36GB 内存

models.note: Cohere Labs · 30B MoE; 19GB is the smallest quantization; Apache-2.0 with a usage policy
models.note_zh: Cohere Labs · 30B MoE;19GB 为最小量化,Apache-2.0 加使用政策

families.desc_zh: 面向代码与长任务的模型:Poolside 的 Laguna XS 2.1(33B MoE,激活 3B)、Cohere 的 North Mini Code(30B MoE)、Ornith 1.5(厂商信息以 Ollama 页面为准)。

selfhost.name: DeepSeek-V4
selfhost.desc: DeepSeek's current open-weight model (weights on Hugging Face; there is no matching model repository on GitHub). 1M context, hybrid attention. Ollama only offers its cloud version, so running it locally means hosting your own service.

models.note: About 155GB at 4-bit quantization (Unsloth docs); the official weights are a mixed FP4+FP8 format
models.note_zh: 4 位量化约 155GB(Unsloth 文档);官方权重为 FP4+FP8 混合

models.note: The official weights need multiple machines and GPUs; for a single machine see community quantizations
models.note_zh: 官方权重需要多机多卡;单机请看社区量化版

models.note: Previous generation (github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3); FP8 weights only, needs multiple GPUs
models.note_zh: 上一代(github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3);仅提供 FP8 权重,需要多卡 GPU

selfhost.desc_zh: DeepSeek 目前最新的开放权重模型(权重在 Hugging Face,GitHub 上没有对应的模型仓库)。1M 上下文,混合注意力。Ollama 只提供它的云端版本,本地运行需要自建服务。

cloud_only.name: kimi-k3
cloud_only.note: Open-weight multimodal agent model; Ollama currently offers only the cloud version
cloud_only.note_zh: 开放权重的多模态智能体模型,Ollama 目前只有云端版

cloud_only.name: glm-5.3
cloud_only.note: GLM flagship; Ollama currently offers only the cloud version
cloud_only.note_zh: GLM 旗舰,Ollama 目前只有云端版

cloud_only.name: deepseek-v4-flash
cloud_only.note: Only the cloud version exists on Ollama; host your own service for local use
cloud_only.note_zh: Ollama 上只有云端版;本地请自建服务

cloud_only.name: minimax-m3
cloud_only.note: Ollama currently offers only the cloud version

note_zh: 型号与大小取自 ollama.com/library 各模型的标签页(2026-09-20 查阅);DeepSeek-V4 的数据来自其 Hugging Face 页面与 Unsloth 文档。大小是默认量化(通常 4 位)的下载体积;强项是根据型号系列与官方标注推断的标签,不是评测成绩。
